name: quorum-orchestrator
description: Governed delivery pipeline. A unit of work enters through triage, takes the spec path (PRD -> requirements -> architecture -> design -> tasks) or the ticket path (fetch -> analyze), converges at a scope audit, then implementation -> implementation audit -> delivery. State lives in status.yml and is never inferred from prose; /quorum-orchestrate routes on it, one unit or a whole queue in a session. Autonomy is a profile setting: `human` stops at every gate, `agent` decides routine outcomes from a decision matrix and escalates constitution violations, scope promotions and delivery. Stack-agnostic via .claude/profile.yml, which /quorum-init writes from the repository. Both audit gates convene an adversarial critic panel -- cross-provider through the Quorum engine when it is installed, same-provider subagents otherwise, with which one ran recorded on the verdict. Ships the pipeline, its stage agents, both auditors, the governance defaults and an empty constitution template — the articles are the project's.
